independence.identity_observation: The assigned reviewer login matches the local Git commit identity configured to publish the candidate; the shared-identity process risk must be reassessed for the new candidate.

review_scope: expected native errors independently established from advisory primary documentation and observed Windows behavior
requirements, verification, decision, and source traceability
collector provenance, artifact integrity, timeout, and failure-state controls
Application Verifier optionality, activation oracle, configuration query, and cleanup query
Driver Verifier no-kernel-driver applicability and host-safety disposition
tool failure modes, fallback adequacy, common-mode dependence, and residual reliance
assurance limitations, non-claims, and gap-closure conditions

checklist.objective: Confirm the reviewed commit, tree, branch, lockfile, native Windows host, target, Rust toolchain, command, native exit, and artifact hashes are exact and clean.
Confirm all eight deterministic OS-mediated and Win32-boundary scenarios execute the intended API boundaries and preserve the actual native errors.
Derive ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, ERROR_LOCK_VIOLATION, and ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE expectations independently of the implementation and collector oracles.
Confirm the unavailable-volume oracle is intentionally host-specific, requires a positive native error, and cannot silently pass on success.
Confirm requirements, verification IDs, decision mappings, source surfaces, and gap references are complete and reciprocal.
Challenge collector and validator failure modes with malformed, stale, dirty, wrong-host, wrong-error, timeout, missing-artifact, and false-review-state cases.
Confirm Application Verifier remains optional user-mode robustness depth and that any claimed pass proves pre-clean absence, exact configuration, observed activation, and post-clean absence.
Confirm Driver Verifier is not applicable because the repository supplies no kernel-mode driver and that unrelated OS or filesystem drivers must not be targeted as fs2 evidence.
Assess common-mode dependencies, independently established expected results, reviewer competence, organizational or process independence, and residual tool reliance.
Confirm approval would satisfy only the registered internal independent-review condition and would not assert certification, qualification, MC/DC, object-code coverage, or authority acceptance.

remaining_conditions: complete a fresh independent review of the bound candidate and record its decision

non_claims: Reviewer assignment is not reviewer acceptance, an independence determination, or review approval.
The shared GitHub identity must be explicitly reassessed for the new candidate and cannot establish broader organizational independence or authority acceptance.
The previous candidate approval is retained in Git history but does not approve the new changed candidate.
This record does not establish certification credit, tool qualification, MC/DC, object-code coverage, or authority acceptance.
